decisions.statement: The companions table is read out of the first account-wide table in the file.
A companions table written as a lua array is read as a record whose first key is `1`.
An entry with no build hash as text is left out.
A definition id no companion in the table carries is reported and left out.
A hash that will not decode is reported against its companion and left out.
A build name is the companion's name and the name of its base roles sorted.
A build with no base role is named for the `no-role` role.
Which companions get a progress page is read off the companion table.
Every companion the game gives a definition id gets a page for the account.
A companion the saved file never mentions still gets a progress page.
A page here is written by `upsertPage` unless the caller states another writer.
A reported line reaches `console.log` unless the caller states another reporter.
A warning reaches `console.warn` unless the caller states another reporter.
A file holding no `Default` table is refused.
A file with no account-wide table is refused.
Nothing here opens the saved-variables file.
The canonical hash a build reads back as reaches no page.

definition: the companion build hashes an addon saved, read back out and named, one page each
